mcqs.question: New Delhi lies at approximately 28.6° N latitude. Which of the following statements correctly describes this latitude?

options.A: It is 28.6 degrees south of the Equator.
options.B: It is 28.6 degrees north of the Equator.
options.C: It is 28.6 degrees east of the Prime Meridian.
options.D: It is 28.6 degrees west of the Prime Meridian.

mcqs.answer: It is 28.6 degrees north of the Equator.
mcqs.explanation: Latitude measures the distance north or south of the Equator. A latitude of 28.6° N means the place is 28.6 degrees north of the Equator. Options A, C, and D refer to south latitude or longitude, which are incorrect.

mcqs.question: A pilot departs from Nairobi (1.3° S, 36.8° E) and flies directly east, staying at the same latitude. Which coordinate will change during the flight?

options.D: Both latitude and longitude will remain the same.

mcqs.explanation: When moving east or west, the latitude (north‑south position) stays the same, while the longitude (east‑west position) changes. Therefore, the longitude value will increase as the aircraft moves east. Options A and B describe latitude changes, which do not occur in this scenario, and D is incorrect because longitude does change.

mcqs.learning_point: Identify the Equator and Prime Meridian
mcqs.question: Which of the following correctly pairs the Equator and the Prime Meridian with their respective coordinate values?
mcqs.explanation: The Equator is the imaginary line that circles the Earth at 0° latitude, dividing the Northern and Southern Hemispheres. The Prime Meridian is the line at 0° longitude, dividing the Eastern and Western Hemispheres. Options B, C, and D mix up latitude and longitude or give incorrect values.

mcqs.learning_point: Locate the Tropic of Cancer and Tropic of Capricorn
mcqs.question: A city is located at 23.5° N latitude. On which of the following lines does it lie?
mcqs.explanation: The Tropic of Cancer is the line of latitude 23.5° north of the Equator. A location at 23.5° N therefore lies exactly on the Tropic of Cancer. The Tropic of Capricorn is at 23.5° S, the Equator at 0°, and the Prime Meridian is a longitude line, not a latitude line.

mcqs.learning_point: Understand the Northern and Southern Hemispheres
mcqs.question: Which statement correctly compares the Northern Hemisphere with the Southern Hemisphere?

options.A: The Northern Hemisphere experiences winter when the Southern Hemisphere experiences summer.
options.B: Both hemispheres have the same amount of daylight throughout the year.
options.C: The Southern Hemisphere contains the Equator, while the Northern Hemisphere does not.
options.D: The Northern Hemisphere has more landmass, but both hemispheres receive equal solar energy.

mcqs.answer: The Northern Hemisphere experiences winter when the Southern Hemisphere experiences summer.
mcqs.explanation: Because the Earth is tilted on its axis, when the Northern Hemisphere is tilted away from the Sun it experiences winter, while the Southern Hemisphere, tilted toward the Sun, experiences summer. Option B is false because daylight varies with seasons. Option C is incorrect; the Equator lies in both hemispheres. Option D is partially true about landmass but the statement about equal solar energy is misleading; the tilt causes seasonal differences.

mcqs.learning_point: Understand the Eastern and Western Hemispheres
mcqs.question: In most competitive examinations, which meridian is identified as the primary divider between the Eastern and Western Hemispheres?
mcqs.explanation: The Prime Meridian at 0° longitude is universally accepted as the main line separating the Eastern Hemisphere (0° to 180° East) from the Western Hemisphere (0° to 180° West). The 180° meridian is the opposite side of the globe and is used for the International Date Line, not as the primary hemispheric divider. Options A and D are arbitrary meridians and are not used for this purpose.

mcqs.learning_point: Locate places using latitude and longitude
mcqs.question: Which coordinate pair correctly locates the Indian city of Chennai?
mcqs.explanation: Chennai is situated on the southeastern coast of India at approximately 13.1 degrees north latitude and 80.3 degrees east longitude. Options B and D place it in the Southern Hemisphere, and option C places it in the Western Hemisphere, all of which are incorrect.

mcqs.learning_point: Understand why coordinates are useful for precise location
mcqs.question: Why are latitude and longitude coordinates preferred over place names when giving a precise location?

options.A: Coordinates are shorter to write than most place names.
options.B: Coordinates are universally understood and do not change with language or political boundaries.
options.C: Place names are always ambiguous, while coordinates are always ambiguous as well.
options.D: Coordinates can be used only on digital maps, making them more modern.

mcqs.answer: Coordinates are universally understood and do not change with language or political boundaries.
mcqs.explanation: Latitude and longitude provide a fixed, numerical reference that is the same worldwide, regardless of language, local naming conventions, or changes in political borders. This makes them ideal for precise navigation and mapping. Option A is irrelevant to precision, C is false because coordinates are not ambiguous, and D incorrectly limits the use of coordinates to digital maps.
